caption: A lamppost on a pier casts its shadow onto the water below, and the shadow rides the ripples.

sa.check: A lamppost stands on a pier.
It casts its shadow onto the water below.
There are ripples on the water.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the water surface away from the sun and stays attached to the base of the post.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or it detaches from the post's base; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the post's long outline and wobbles with the waves.
pc.fail: It is rigid and straight on a plainly rippled surface; or a different shape; or it splits into pieces unrelated to the ripples.

pc.expect: The post stays still and the shadow moves only with the water.
pc.fail: The post sways; or the shadow moves on a flat calm; or the shadow swings round.

pc.expect: The ripples pass and the water surface stays liquid.
pc.fail: The water is rigid like glass with a wobbling shadow; or the ripples freeze; or the water flows uphill.
A second post or shadow appears; or the post vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the post passes through the pier.

pc.expect: The post and the pier stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The post changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the pier changes.
